proj1.title: Lia — AI Hotel Chatbot
proj1.desc: Designed and built Lia, an AI chatbot for inventory management and price negotiation in the hospitality sector. Contributed to 50+ direct bookings for Galle Face Hotel within months of launch. Architected a SQL-based LLM agent that dynamically generates and executes complex queries, cutting generation time by 50% vs the prior MemGPT solution.

proj2.title: Kaya AI Platform — Low-Code Agentic AI
proj2.desc: Implemented core features on the Kaya AI Platform, a low-code solution for building and managing agentic AI systems supporting text and audio-based conversational agents with RAG, graph RAG, MCP, and self-learning integrations. Built the data lineage feature to track and visualise data flow across agent graphs.

proj3.title: Med-QnA — Medical Question Answering System
proj3.desc: AI-powered medical question answering system that provides accurate, context-aware responses to healthcare queries. Built with advanced NLP techniques and fine-tuned language models to handle domain-specific medical terminology.

proj4.title: SlimAtlas AI — Lightweight Browser for AI Agents
proj4.desc: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides extremely lightweight browser automation capabilities using Lightpanda browser. This server enables LLMs to interact with web pages through browser automation. Works with MacOS and Linux. Built on top of Puppeteer and Lightpanda browser.

proj5.title: Fine-tuning LLaMA 7B for Intent Classification
proj5.desc: Led a team of 10 to build and annotate a domain-specific chat dataset over 1.5 months. Applied transfer learning, LoRA, and quantisation to fine-tune LLaMA 7B for 50+ intent classes, achieving 80% accuracy with a lightweight architecture.

proj6.title: Kaya Apex — AI Training Platform
proj6.desc: Designed goal-oriented prompts driving natural avatar behaviour in interactive training sessions. Built an LLM-based evaluation system assessing user performance against predefined criteria. Led optimisation effort that significantly improved platform efficiency.

proj7.title: ReCodeAct Agent — Reasoning + Code Action LLM
proj7.desc: Research project integrating chain-of-thought reasoning with executable code generation as the action layer, enabling error detection and significantly improving agent decision-making reliability over standard text-output agents.

proj8.title: ReviewSpotter — Customer Review Analysis
proj8.desc: Built sentiment analysis pipelines processing 100,000+ customer reviews for the travel and tourism sector. Applied advanced NLP techniques to improve detection accuracy and integrated models with Elasticsearch for efficient large-scale data retrieval and analysis.

proj9.title: Dynamic Subscription Management — Kaya AI Platform
proj9.desc: Designed and built an event-driven integration layer connecting Kafka streams and message queues to agentic workflows. Enabled real-time workflow triggering, live streaming of agent outputs, stateful resumption of interrupted workflows, and a self-learning feedback loop.

proj10.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection With Catboost
proj10.desc: In this project I trained Catboost algorithm for detecting credit card frauds. This problem belongs to a anomaly detection category of machine learning. I had a labeled dataset with 0.01% of fraud rate. Goal was to achieve maximum recall with acceptable precision.

proj11.title: Face Mask Detector
proj11.desc: Created and trained a CNN model to detect whether a person is wearing a mask. Uses haar cascade classifier in OpenCV for face detection and a TensorFlow CNN model for classification. Built both a Python GUI and a browser-based web app using TensorFlow.js and OpenCV.js.

proj12.title: Football Data Analyzer
proj12.desc: Custom Python application for a client to analyze football match performance — sprint distance, heat maps, sprint maps, heart rate data. Converts GPS coordinates to local x,y coordinates using ECEF transformations. Built with PyQt5, NumPy, and XML parsing for .gpx files.

proj13.title: Wizard Chess — Unity 3D Game
proj13.desc: 3D chess game with live piece animations made in Unity, based on the Harry Potter wizard chess. Developed the MiniMax AI algorithm from scratch in C#. Created all 3D models and animations in Blender 3D.

proj14.title: Simple Renderer — C++ OpenGL Library
proj14.desc: Portable C++ library for creating and rendering simple 3D scenes using OpenGL. Features basic lighting with multiple lights, color mapping, materials, GLSL shaders, shadows, and a rich transform system. Avoids long OpenGL initialization codes with a clean scene graph API.

proj15.title: Tower Defence — Unity Game
proj15.desc: 3D tower defense game developed as a freelance project. Players defeat enemy waves by placing turrets, bombs, and other structures. 3 levels with increasing difficulty. Enemy characters use state machine-based AI. All 3D models created in Blender 3D.

proj16.title: Online Course Platform Front-end
proj16.desc: I developed this front end for a University group project using Vue js framework. This is for an online video course management system. Users can sign up as teachers or students. Teachers can create courses and upload edit course content. Students can enroll in courses and watch course videos. And also it has an admin account type with the privilege to delete courses and add/delete new categories. It also has features like course search and sort. For the front end, I used bootstrap and css for styling.

proj17.title: Railway Ticketing System - PC controller
proj17.desc: This was a part of a 3rd-year university project (group). The project was to create an easy, reliable, and fast method to overcome issues of using an ordinary paper ticket system for trains in Sri Lanka. It consists of automatic gates, swiping cards, and a hand-held card scanning device. Automatic gates are controlled by Arduino. Passengers can open gates by swiping their cards at the gates. I created this Java application to connect the computer at the station to the central server. And also communicate with Arduino to control the gate based on the command send by the server. And also it comes with a very easy-to-use JavaFX GUI to connect gates and view status. Jserialcomm library was used to connect the application to the Arduino board inside the gate. And also Apache HTTP client to make HTTP requests.

proj18.title: Multizip
proj18.desc: One problem with the built-in python Zip file module was it cannot extract zip files with multiple parts. We can create an archive with multiple parts in order to reduce the size of the zip file and make them easy to transfer. I created this Multizip python module to extract files from this kind of multiple zip file. It currently does not support encryptions. But I am looking forward to adding that too.
